Full honesty, one of the reasons I love roleplaying is that it offers some safety to step into other shoes and test socialization in ways that isn't safe in real life. Being autistic I can say rpgs has done more for figuring out social cues than any other single thing hands down. (even if I still have issues with that sometimes.) I really value that aspect of the format and now have some concerns if it isn't as safe a format for this type of exploration as I assumed. @everyone When we designed this game it was intended to have 4 active factions. 4 separate stories, each with their own separate quests to work toward influencing the ending. Through no fault of their own two of the DMs had to become less active. This left us with a Bi-Partisan system winner take all scenario.
